vocabulary.definition: having a greater number than the opponent
vocabulary.example: The small village was outnumbered by the approaching army.

vocabulary.definition: the mass or magnitude of something large
vocabulary.example: The bulk of the population lived in the urban areas.
The team decided to split into two groups for better efficiency.
There was a sense of panic in the crowd when the fire alarm went off.
